Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a small, hypoplastic right lung with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (dextroposition of the heart) and a curvilinear opacity in the right lower zone (indicated by the arrow), which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein characteristic of Scimitar syndrome. The accompanying CT images confirm right lung hypoplasia and vascular anomalies consistent with this congenital condition.
